import json,collections
d=json.load(open('positions.json'))
def st(L,n):
    if not L: print(n,'none'); return
    w=[p for p in L if p['net_pct']>0]; l=[p for p in L if p['net_pct']<=0]
    gp=sum(p['pnl_usd'] for p in w); gl=-sum(p['pnl_usd'] for p in l)
    R=[p['r_mult'] for p in L]
    print(n,'n',len(L),'win',len(w),'sumR',round(sum(R),2),'avgR',round(sum(R)/len(R),3),'usd',round(sum(p['pnl_usd'] for p in L),3),'avgW%',round(sum(p['net_pct'] for p in w)/max(1,len(w)),2),'avgL%',round(sum(p['net_pct'] for p in l)/max(1,len(l)),2),'PF',round(gp/gl,2) if gl else None)
C=[p for p in d if p['status']=='closed']
st(C,'ALL'); st([p for p in C if p.get('src')!='chan'],'WATCH'); st([p for p in C if p.get('src')=='chan'],'CHAN')
for r in sorted(set(p.get('rule') for p in C if p.get('rule'))): st([p for p in C if p.get('rule')==r],r)
for s in ('long','short'): st([p for p in C if p.get('src')=='chan' and p['side']==s],'chan_'+s)
print(collections.Counter(p['reason'] for p in C if p.get('src')=='chan'))
print('chan R each',[(p['id'],p['r_mult'],p['reason'],p['R_pct']) for p in C if p.get('src')=='chan'])
print('t range',min(p['t_in'] for p in C),max(p['t_out'] for p in C))
print('chan first t',min(p['t_in'] for p in C if p.get('src')=='chan'))
O=[p for p in d if p['status']=='open']
for p in O: print('open',p['id'],p['sym'],p['side'],p['entry'],p['stop'],p['tp'],p.get('hi'),p.get('lo'),p['t_in'])
